extraFacts.fact: Sibling ranges: 304 seamless 1/8" to 1-1/2" O.D., 0.028" to 0.134" wall; 316 seamless 1/8" to 1-1/4" O.D., 0.020" to 0.250" wall; 304 welded 3/16" to 2" O.D., 0.028" to 0.120" wall; 316 welded 3/16" to 2" O.D., 0.028" to 0.083" wall.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics listings for the inch stainless steel instrumentation tubing range

extraFacts.fact: ASTM A269 covers seamless and welded austenitic stainless steel tubing for general service; ASTM A213 covers seamless austenitic and ferritic alloy-steel boiler, superheater and heat-exchanger tubes; ASTM A270 covers seamless and welded austenitic stainless steel sanitary tubing.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A269, ASTM A213 and ASTM A270 scope statements

extraFacts.fact: 3-A is the US sanitary-standards system for dairy and food-contact equipment, which A270 tubing is made to suit.
316 stainless steel contains molybdenum, which gives better resistance to chloride pitting and crevice corrosion than 304, so it is the usual choice for marine, offshore and salt-air duty.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A269 grade compositions (TP304, TP316); Indus guide: stainless tube fittings and tubing in salt air

faqs.q: What is 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch used for?
faqs.a: 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch is 304 stainless steel seamless tube in inch outside diameters, for instrument, sample, hydraulic and process lines made up with compression tube fittings. It covers 1/8" to 1-1/2" O.D. in 0.028" to 0.134" wall, in twenty-eight part numbers, to ASTM A269 and ASTM A213.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers of 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch, such as IH-TB-ST4-02-0.028?
faqs.a: In the 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch table the two digits after the grade code are the outside diameter in sixteenths of an inch and the last figure is the wall in inches: IH-TB-ST4-02-0.028 is 1/8" O.D. tube, 0.028" wall, IH-TB-ST4-10-0.065 is 5/8" O.D. tube, 0.065" wall and IH-TB-ST4-24-0.134 is 1-1/2" O.D. tube, 0.134" wall. Each part number is one O.D. in one wall.

faqs.q: What outside diameters and walls does 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch come in?
faqs.a: 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch comes in ten outside diameters, 1/8", 1/4", 5/16", 3/8", 1/2", 5/8", 3/4", 1", 1-1/4" and 1-1/2", in walls from 0.028" to 0.134" wall. Each part number is one O.D. in one wall, so for example 1/8" O.D. tube, 0.028" wall and 1-1/2" O.D. tube, 0.134" wall are separate lines.

faqs.q: Which wall thicknesses are listed for 1/4" 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch?
faqs.a: The 1/4" size of 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch is listed in walls of 0.035", 0.049" and 0.065", each under its own part number. The wall sets the pressure the tube can hold and must suit the fitting maker's allowed range, so quote the O.D. and wall together.

faqs.q: What length and minimum order apply to 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch?
faqs.a: 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch is supplied in 20 ft lengths with a minimum order of 200 ft. Quote the O.D., wall and total length, and price, lead time and freight are confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.q: What pressure is 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch rated for?
faqs.a: The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch. A tube holds what its O.D., wall, grade and temperature allow, so tell us your working pressure and temperature and we confirm the wall to use; our [tubing pressure rating guide](/blog/instrumentation-tubing-pressure-ratings) explains the derating.

faqs.q: What grade of stainless steel is 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch and where does it suit?
faqs.a: 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch is 304 stainless steel. 304 is a general-purpose stainless grade for indoor and mild-environment instrument lines; choose 316 for marine, offshore or salt-air duty.

faqs.q: Which standards does 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch meet?
faqs.a: 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch is listed to ASTM A269 and ASTM A213. ASTM A269 covers seamless and welded austenitic stainless tubing for general service, and ASTM A213 covers seamless austenitic and ferritic tubes for boilers, superheaters and heat exchangers. Ask us for mill test certificates if your project needs them; none are attached to this listing.

faqs.q: Which tube fittings suit 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch?
faqs.a: 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch is made for compression tube fittings, which grip on the tube O.D.; match the fitting to the same O.D. and wall range. See our [double-ferrule tube fittings](/c/double-ferrule-tube-fittings) and [single-ferrule tube fittings](/c/single-ferrule-tube-fittings) for the fittings that go with it.

faqs.q: How should 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch be prepared for a compression fitting?
faqs.a: For 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch (0.028" to 0.134" wall), use fully annealed tube of the right hardness, cut it square, deburr it, and stay inside the wall range the fitting maker allows for each size. A tube that is too hard or too thin-walled will not seal, so quote the wall with the O.D.

faqs.q: How does 304 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch differ from 316 grade?
faqs.a: The 316 seamless range adds molybdenum for better pitting resistance and goes to a heavier 0.250" wall but stops at 1-1/4" O.D. See the [316 Stainless Steel Seamless Tubing, Inch](/p/316-stainless-steel-seamless-tubing-inch) for that range, and choose by the corrosion environment and whether the specification calls for a seamless tube.
